summary: Steel 65-foot fire tower north of Sciotoville, Scioto County, Ohio; erected 1929, manned in 1934, NHLR-registered 2014 and listed as standing; access unknown.

events.note: Inferred from a February 1930 report that the tower was erected 'last October'; no exact day given
Grass fire near Jackson Pike beyond Minford, about 20.5 acres of grass and 3.5 acres of woods; the first fire of the season seen from the tower
Telephone service added through the Sciotoville exchange
Manned by Fred J. Etterling, with Clarence Etterling as substitute (Chillicothe Gazette item, October 27, 1934, as quoted by the Forest Lookouts site)

notes_for_editor: Build year 1929 is inferred: the February 20, 1930 Plymouth Daily Times item quoted by the Forest Lookouts site says 'erected last October'. Height 19.8 m is the brief's figure, which converts the 65-foot height in the March 1930 Forest Worker item. The 1930 report names the suspect 'Mr. Bradford' and says the fire was put out by Fire Warden F.J. Etterling and Robert Bradbury; the story names none of them. Staffing is historical only (1934); no current staffing source. Access, visit and current condition are unsupported and left out of facts; the story says so. The NHLR detail page credits a Scott Gilmore photo but gives no image URL, so no photos were added. The FFLOS 'Standing' row has no asterisk, which the list's own note links to towers with the cab gone; this is an inference from the list's convention, not a stated condition. Not verified: any post-2014 restoration or closure.
